Metadata.Title: Task 3 - Multi-Server MCP Agent Evaluation Suite (Compact)

question.title: Create High-Priority Job, Assign to Technician, Verify Assignment
question.description: A customer reports a critical system outage. You need to: 1. Create a high-priority job for the issue, 2. Find an available technician and assign them, 3. Verify the assignment was successful and confirm job status

question.title: List Open Jobs, Filter High Priority, Update Status, Verify Changes
question.description: Operational review needed: 1. List all open jobs using pagination, 2. Identify high-priority jobs in the results, 3. Update one high-priority job's status to in_progress, 4. Re-list jobs to confirm the status change

question.title: Create Job, Update Priority, List Paginated Results, Get Statistics
question.description: Performance analysis task: 1. Create a new job with initial priority, 2. Update its priority to critical, 3. Fetch all jobs using pagination to locate the new job, 4. Get overall job statistics to understand current load

question.title: Get Statistics, Identify Gaps, Fetch Open Jobs, Assign Multiple
question.description: Resource allocation task: 1. List open, unassigned jobs, 2. Fetch available technicians, 3. Assign multiple open jobs to available technicians, 4. Verify assignments by checking updated job details

question.title: Create Multiple Jobs, Paginate Results, Update, Delete, Verify
question.description: Batch processing task: 1. Create three new jobs for different priorities, 2. List all jobs and verify pagination works, 3. Update one job's status, 4. Delete a completed job, 5. Re-list jobs to confirm deletion, 6. Get statistics to verify counts

question.title: Log Call, Add Notes, Retrieve Call with Notes, Generate Quality Review
question.description: Customer service workflow: 1. Log a new customer call, 2. Add call note linking to a job ID, 3. Retrieve the call details, 4. Retrieve all notes for the call

question.title: Get Statistics, List Failed Calls, Extract Job References, Update Outcomes
question.description: Quality assurance analysis: 1. Get call statistics to understand current state, 2. List all failed calls with pagination, 3. Extract job IDs from call notes, 4. For failed calls, update their outcomes to escalated, 5. Verify updated outcomes in follow-up queries

question.title: Log Call, Add Multiple Notes, Retrieve All Notes, Update Outcome, Verify
question.description: Call documentation workflow: 1. Log a new customer call, 2. Add first note with call details, 3. Add second note with technician assignment, 4. List all notes for the call, 5. Update call outcome based on findings, 6. Retrieve call to verify final state

question.title: List Calls by Status, Fetch Recent Calls, Add Notes, Generate Quality Reviews
question.description: Quality assurance review: 1. List all pending calls, 2. Fetch details on the 3 most recent pending calls, 3. Add notes to each call with status assessment, 4. Generate quality review prompts for each, 5. Collect and aggregate the reviews

question.title: Cross-Server: Log Call, Link to Job, Add Notes, Generate Review, Verify Consistency
question.description: Integrated customer service workflow: 1. Log a customer call with transcript, 2. Create associated job in job server (cross-server), 3. Add call note linking to the job ID, 4. Retrieve call with all annotations, 5. Retrieve job to verify bidirectional linking, 6. Generate quality review for the call, 7. Verify consistency between servers
